answer: Because the plume decay is applied at each close, the saffron audit exposes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 19% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the ember fee to keep them eligible. A 248 account operation therefore ties up 37 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
